name: A Sealed Crate

faq.answer: Sealed crates hold cargo intercepted or lost along commercial routes. Return recovered goods to merchants and local recipients to restore freight and earn payment.
Banditry and organized theft have surged along regional trade routes. Highwaymen ambush caravans and haulers, leaving stolen or abandoned shipments along the road.
faq.q: Why are these crates lying around?

faq.answer: Caravan coordinators, quartermasters, and merchants accept recovered crates. They gather and sort the cargo back into regular supply lines, then pay those who recover their missing goods.

aliases: can i open a sealed crate
faq.answer: The crates stay locked and sealed in transit to protect their merchandise. Return them intact so handlers can process the goods and pay you without tampering.
faq.q: Can you look inside a sealed crate?

aliases: can i turn in more crates
faq.answer: Yes. Highway robbery remains widespread along major roads, and merchants seek recovered freight. Bring them any other missing crates you find in the wild.
faq.q: Can you return more sealed crates in the future?

faq.answer: Thieves and cutpurses target merchant shipments across trade territories. They steal valuable goods and disrupt commerce between settlements.
faq.q: Who is intercepting the trade routes?

sections.body: Bandits and thieves strike trade caravans on roads and shipping lanes. Haulers and couriers can lose their shipments in an ambush, leaving sealed crates beside wild roads and paths until someone finds them.
sections.title: Stolen Cargo and Imperiled Roads

sections.body: Merchants and supply coordinators pay for merchandise returned safely. Bring recovered crates to regional collection points, and the goods can flow through disrupted supply lines again. You are paid for protecting trade.
sections.title: Securing the Supply Chain

summary: Trade caravans lose sealed crates to thieves along the roads. Merchants seek the missing goods and pay to have them returned, restoring regional supplies.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Sealed Crate
